op.description: Indicates an operation which should be done on a return. Available operations: `add` `remove` and `replace`

path.description: Indicates a path for which the value should be applied. For example:`/mixins/additionalAttributes/externalId`, `/name`, `/status`

value.description: Indicates a value that should be changed or added. The value can be of a primitive type, like string, number, boolean or it can be an object or an array.
